title: macOS Golden Gate 27.3 Beta 2 Now Available for Developers

Apple Releases macOS Golden Gate 27.2

Monday October 26, 2026 10:48 am PDT by Juli Clover

Apple today released macOS Golden Gate 27.2, the first major update to the macOS 27 operating system that launched in September. Mac users can download macOS Golden Gate 27.2 by opening up the System Settings app and using the Software Update option. macOS Golden Gate 27.2 overhauls the brightness and volume sliders, plus it expands Siri AI to new languages including French, Japanese,...

macOS 27.2 Stops Upgrades From Removing Rosetta

Upgrading to macOS 27 no longer removes an existing Rosetta installation, according to Apple's enterprise release notes for macOS 27.2. Previously, upgrading to macOS 27 removed existing installations of Rosetta, the translation tool that lets Intel-based apps run on Apple silicon Macs. macOS 27 remains the final release with full Rosetta support. Apple plans to phase out general-purpose...

Apple Releases macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1

Monday November 9, 2026 10:13 am PST by Juli Clover

Apple today released macOS Golden Gate 27.2.1, a minor update for the macOS Golden Gate operating system. macOS Golden Gate includes bug fixes and security updates, according to Apple's release notes. The update likely includes a fix to prevent command-line tools from accepting eMudhra's compromised web certificates. Apple already blocked the compromised certificates on October 19, so...
